title: Determinant polynomial of an idempotent summand
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $T,P$ square matrices indexed by a finite set $J$. Define $D(T,P)=\det(1-C(P)+(X1-C(T))C(P))\in A[X]$, where $C$ applies the constant-polynomial map entrywise. The characteristic matrix $X1-C(T)$ is the one defining the free characteristic polynomial [def-weil-pbc-charpoly-free-module]. The formula is defined for arbitrary $T,P$, without idempotence or commutation hypotheses.
